text:
maria: heads up — onboarding for AcmeCorp hit a snag. New users are being provisioned twice. seeing SCIM 409s in audit, but also SAML JIT created accounts with a different identifier.
kevin: can you paste the SCIM error and the SAML NameID from a failing flow?
maria: SCIM log: `{"status":409,"error":"userExists","detail":"resource with externalId already exists"}`
maria: SAML decoded (redacted):
```
<NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient\">_abc123~acme</NameID>
<Attribute Name=\"email\">alice@acme.com</Attribute>
```
jen: looks like IdP is sending transient NameID; our JIT uses NameID as external_id unless mapping overrides. transient will be different each assertion => duplicates.
sam: ohhh that explains the double-accounts. We should prefer email for external_id and only use NameID when persistent/eduPersonTargetedID.
maria: @kevin can we change the SCIM/JIT mapping for just AcmeCorp? Need a quick rollback plan in case it breaks existing customers.
kevin: yes — two options: 1) mapping rule: external_id = attributes.email, 2) if NameID Format == persistent use NameID. I'll prepare a canary for two users.
idp-bot: [alert] provisioning-runner/42 created 2 users for tenant acme (canary)
jen: also check audit logs for KMS signature verification errors — we had a key rotation last week and some IdPs were sending old-signed assertions. If signature fails we fallback to JIT path that uses NameID.
maria: where do I look for those signature failures in the audit?
jen: look at /console/audit/provisioning with filter `eventType:saml_verification_failed` and `tenant:acme`. Should show `signature_kid` mismatch or `clock_skew` failures.
kevin: I pulled logs: two `saml_verification_failed` for acme between 10:12-10:14, reason `kid not found`. Also one `scim_create 409` at 10:15.
sam: that suggests the IdP had an old signing key; we should ask Acme to re-publish metadata or rotate keys. Meanwhile mapping change avoids duplicates.
maria: can we do a hotfix to prefer email if present? Also need to record change in audit for compliance.
kevin: yes. I'll create a patch: fallback order `[email, persistent_nameid, nameid]`. Will add audit note: `rbac.mapping_change: acme_jit_external_id_rule` and tag change with deploy ID.
audit-bot: [audit] change-recorded user:kevin action:modify mapping target:tenant:acme id:chg-2026-743
jen: quick tests: 1) simulate assertion with transient NameID + email -> single user created; 2) persistent NameID only -> create user with NameID external_id; 3) missing email and transient NameID -> block and escalate.
kevin: running tests now on staging.
[~60s pause]
kevin: staging results: test 1 good, test 2 good, test 3 fails intentionally (blocked). deploying canary to prod for Acme (2 users) in 5m.
maria: before prod, ping Acme SSO contact and ask them about key rotation and whether they can switch NameID format. I'll open a ticket with their IdP team.
sam: also add a note in runbook: "If duplicates appear after IdP work, check NameID format and KMS key ids; prefer email mapping."
maria: created ticket ACME-SSO-125 and added relevant logs + snippet. tagging @kevin for rollout.
kevin: deploying canary now. monitor dashboards for scim 4xx and `duplicate_user_rate`.
idp-bot: [deploy] mapping-canary deployed to tenant acme by kevin (deploy/881)
kevin: canaries green for 10m, no new 409s. rolling to full for tenant.
maria: thanks team. I'll follow up with Acme to clean up duplicate accounts and document the compliance audit entry. :thumbsup:
